exposure: Glycemic control (glycemic mean, glycated hemoglobin levels)
Diabetes status (no diabetes, gestational diabetes mellitus, previous type 1 or type 2 diabetes)
outcome: Placental villous vessel distribution (number, area, perimeter, percentage of peripheral blood)
cohort: The study participants were 30 pregnant women, divided into groups based on their diabetes status (no diabetes, GDM, and previous type 1 or type 2 diabetes).
finding: Maternal glycemic levels, particularly in women with previous type 1 or type 2 diabetes, are associated with a reduction in the number, area, and perimeter of peripheral vessels in placental villi, suggesting potential placental villous immaturity.
cross-section timing: At the time of elective cesarean section
